title: 1 prompt game? Nah. I'll take my time.
author: xcantene
selftext:
This is a project I have been working for about 2 years first on physical. I was building a simple demo to test and balance my cards but it was quite ugly.

Then I lost my job 3 months ago as Senior UX designer and got replaced by some AI agents. So bet. I decided to go full on this game. I doubt it will grow but I am proud of how far I have gotten. There is still a lot to tweak and fix but it is getting there. 

What do you guys think? I have been working on crafting some extra sound effects and lately making a proper tutorial with a guide mascot.

comments.author: RUSuper
comments.body:
I like it. Has some wild rift vibes. But some elements of UI seem too empty. Some have particle effects which are nice, some have background images which again are nice but some are way too big of a contrast with having a lot of space empty in them. I think you should put progress as you work on it so it maybe gains some traction.

It’s obvious that this is no slop and that a lot of work was put into it. Best of luck in the future 🤗

replies.author: xcantene
replies.body:
Thank you. 
I have been putting a lot of effort into it. 

Yes I am still improving cleaning and working on new animations creating sound effects and recording some voice lines to bring some characters to life.

comments.author: ArialBear
comments.body: Looks great! Honestly, love the card designs

comments.author: Impressive_Award_679
comments.body: It always feels so good seeing people using AI to make something they would play themselves instead of burning tokens to oneshot stuff no one asks for. Looks really good. Really like the style.

comments.author: AfternoonMany8117
comments.body: Legends Of Runeterra + Vault Of The void ? it looks good though.

comments.author: obnoxiouscheese
comments.body:
There is no such thing as a good game made with one prompt. Misinformed people will pretend otherwise, but each and all good game needs to have effort and soul poured into it. As long as you:
- have care for your project
- polish it the best you can
- and of course, are open to acquiring the knowledge on how to actually polish it and making it the best expression of your vision
Then the actual tools you are using make no difference.

Btw, your project looks so good! Congrats!
